content.text: So far, Sb fractions of 0.61, 0.70 and 0.77 all give about the same EQE (~0.008%), and Sb 0.39 gives none. I'm using my last EQE measurement just below the plateau, at index 15 (Sb 0.556).

input.rationale: Of the 5 compositions measured, EQE is highest across a broad Sb-rich plateau: Sb 0.6085 gives 0.0083%, 0.699 gives 0.0082% and 0.774 gives 0.0078%. It falls to 0.0062% at Sb 0.556 and to about zero at Sb 0.393. Index 17 (Sb 0.61) has the highest measured value. This fits Sb-rich rutile or trirutile Cr–Sb–O (CrSbO4/CrSb2O6-type) being the photoactive phase.

rejected.reason: Not measured; activity falls off toward Cr-rich compositions, and Cr2O3-dominated films are unlikely to be good photoanodes

content.text:
I submitted **index 17 (Sb fraction 0.6085)** as the best composition, with a measured EQE of 0.0083%. That was the highest of the five compositions I measured, and all five EQE measurements are now used.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 0.393 | −0.001 |
| 15 | 0.556 | 0.0062 |
| **17** | **0.609** | **0.0083** |
| 20 | 0.699 | 0.0082 |
| 23 | 0.774 | 0.0078 |

- **Flat top:** EQE is nearly level between Sb 0.61 and 0.77, so the lead of index 17 over index 20 is very small. The true peak could be at an unmeasured composition in that range, but the plateau suggests it isn't much higher.
- **Unchecked Sb-rich end:** activity drops toward the Cr-rich side, but I didn't measure anything above Sb 0.77 (indices 24–27). A rise there hasn't been ruled out.
- **Phase not confirmed:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements. The idea that the active phase is an Sb-rich Cr–Sb–O rutile-type oxide is a guess from composition, not something the data shows.
- **Cr-rich end not measured:** I skipped Sb below about 0.39, as expected from the trend and from Cr₂O₃ usually being a poor photoanode.
